name: State Space Constraint Obfuscation
description: Translates a structural graph property (presence of a specific subgraph) into an equivalent constraint satisfaction problem over a small state space (e.g., 0 valid 2-colorings out of 8 possible states). This defeats algebraic pattern matching and forces the model to logically deduce the necessary structural conditions (like finding a triangle) to avoid writing a naive, TLE-prone brute-force search.
